description: This file defines classes and functions related to OAuth2 security schemes in a FastAPI application, including password flow forms, OAuth2 dependencies, and scope management.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: A dependency class to collect OAuth2 password flow form data including username, password, scopes, client_id, and client_secret.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestFormStrict
classes.description: A strict dependency class inheriting from OAuth2PasswordRequestForm, requiring the grant_type field to be 'password'.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Base class for OAuth2 security schemes, encapsulating OAuth2 flow configuration.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
classes.description: A dependency class implementing OAuth2 password flow for bearer token authentication.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer
classes.description: A dependency class implementing OAuth2 authorization code flow for bearer token authentication.

classes.name: SecurityScopes
classes.description: A class to define and manage OAuth2 scopes required by dependencies in a FastAPI application.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 Unauthorized exception with WWW-Authenticate header for OAuth2.

methods.name: Optional[str] __call__(self, request: Request)
methods.description: Async method to retrieve the Authorization header from the request and validate the scheme.
